author: Sun
developer_reply: Account registration ensures your data syncs securely across all your devices in real-time, allowing you to access your visual planner, tasks, and routines anywhere you go. It also keeps your data safe if you switch or lose your phone. I try to keep setup as quick as possible, but I completely appreciate your feedback on this step!

developer_reply: Thank you for your review! We will add support for multiple languages very soon. Please recommend our app to your friends, and don’t hesitate to shoot us a note at https://thruday.com/support if you have any questions.

author: SOLMARIE6989 (solmarie6989)
developer_reply: Thruday is 100% free to download and use! Without paying a penny, you get unrestricted access to our core visual planner, to-do lists, mood tracking, and a library of 4,000+ images. Optional premium features exist solely to keep the app ad-free and running. I promise you can fully plan your days without ever spending money!
